component.name: Sheaf
component.summary: Browse and search your recent and favorite files

description.p: Sheaf keeps the files you recently opened, and the ones you marked as favorites, in one place. It handles documents, PDFs, books, pictures, audio, video and everything else, with thumbnails, tags, groups and fast search.
It reads the standard recent files list that other applications already write, so there is nothing to set up.
